scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Asymptotic midpoint uniform convexity and unbounded diamond distortion in a reflexive tree space” (preprints/Asymptotic-midpoint-uniform-convexity-and-unbounded-diamond-distortion-in-a-reflexive-tree-space-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1e08111eaf334a06), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The space X = J∗ defined by (1.4) is infinite dimensional, separable, and reflexive, and has no equivalent AUC norm. Its given norm satisfies b δX(t) ≥ q 1 + t2/12 − 1 (t > 0). For every integer k ≥ 0, every embedding of Dk into X has distortion at least p 1 + k/12.
